title: 'iPhone Ultra' Could Face Staggered Market Rollout, US Only at Launch
excerpt: Apple's upcoming foldable "iPhone Ultra" may see a staggered country-by-country launch over several months, with initial availability...
content_html:
Thursday August 13, 2026 5:56 am PDT by Tim Hardwick

Apple's upcoming foldable "iPhone Ultra" may see a staggered country-by-country launch over several months, with initial availability limited to the U.S. market, according to an Australian publication.


In a report labeled "exclusive," ChannelNews said today it has been told by local carriers and one major retailer that Apple's first foldable iPhone will be a "no show" when the iPhone 18 Pro models launch in September, despite being unveiled together. Instead, Apple will release the book-style device in the U.S. market first, followed by key markets including China over two or three months.

The staggered launch is said to be due to supply setbacks and "pricing problems." The publication's sources also claim that Apple is "having testing issues with production models that have already been built."

Apple analyst Ming-Chi Kuo claimed last month that Apple would unveil its first foldable iPhone at the same time as the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, but that iPhone Ultra pre-orders would start at a later date than the latter models.

Kuo said manufacturing challenges have limited early production, but this is the first time we have heard that a staggered country rollout could be another consequence of continuing supply issues.

Vision Pro All Over Again?

It wouldn't be the first time Apple has launched a new product in a staggered manner. When the Vision Pro launched in February 2024, it was only available in the U.S. initially. The headset was later launched in China, Hong Kong, Japan, and Singapore in June, followed by Australia, Canada, France, Germany, and the UK in July.

The reasons for the Vision Pro's staggered launch came down to low volume production, retail store readiness, and the fact that it was an entirely new category for Apple. All three could arguably apply to the company's first foldable.

Multiple reports have suggested the iPhone Ultra's production has faced hurdles because of the complexity of the device, with the hinge structure and display durability testing having been the principal bottlenecks. However, those issues were thought to have been resolved during trial production at Foxconn, with Apple subsequently raising its order to around 10 million units, up from 7-8 million units for the year, according to Nikkei Asia.

That said, 10 million units amounts to only a third of Kuo's forecast of 20-22 million units for iPhone 18 Pro models this year. Meanwhile, Kuo still believes Apple's supplier will ship only 7-8 million foldable iPhones in 2026. At such a relatively small number, Apple would presumably struggle to stock 40+ countries on launch day.

It's worth bearing in mind that a staggered market launch is a claim made by the report's sources, and remains uncorroborated. Either way, we should know for sure soon enough. The iPhone Ultra's unveiling is only a matter of weeks away, and we're expecting it to feature an inner display of around 7.7 to 7.8 inches, a 5.5-inch cover screen, a thickness of roughly 4.5mm, and a starting price above $2,000. Apple's iPhone event is most likely going to happen on Tuesday, September 8 or Wednesday, September 9.

content_html_zh:
太平洋夏令时间 2026 年 8 月 13 日星期四上午 5:56 作者：Tim Hardwick

据澳大利亚一家出版物报道，苹果即将推出的可折叠“iPhone Ultra”可能会在几个月内在各个国家交错推出，最初的供应仅限于美国市场。

ChannelNews 今天在一份标有“独家”的报道中表示，当地运营商和一家主要零售商告知，苹果首款可折叠 iPhone 将在 9 月份 iPhone 18 Pro 机型发布时“缺席”，尽管它们是一起亮相的。 相反，苹果将首先在美国市场发布这款书本式设备，然后在两三个月内在包括中国在内的主要市场发布。

据说，交错推出是由于供应受挫和“定价问题”。 该出版物的消息来源还声称，苹果“正在对已经制造的生产模型进行测试问题”。

苹果分析师郭明池上个月声称，苹果将与 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 同时推出首款可折叠 iPhone，但 iPhone Ultra 的预订开始时间将晚于后者。

郭表示，制造方面的挑战限制了早期生产，但这是我们第一次听说，错开的国家推出可能是持续供应问题的另一个后果。

Vision Pro 又来了？

这并不是苹果第一次以交错的方式推出新产品。 Vision Pro 于 2024 年 2 月推出时，最初仅在美国销售。 该耳机随后于 6 月在中国、香港、日本和新加坡推出，随后于 7 月在澳大利亚、加拿大、法国、德国和英国推出。

Vision Pro 交错推出的原因在于产量低、零售店准备就绪以及它对苹果来说是一个全新的类别。 这三者可以说都适用于该公司的第一款可折叠产品。

多份报告表明，由于设备复杂，iPhone Ultra 的生产面临障碍，其中铰链结构和显示屏耐用性测试是主要瓶颈。 然而，据《日经亚洲》报道，这些问题被认为在富士康试生产期间已得到解决，苹果随后将订单量从当年的 7-800 万台提高到了 1000 万台左右。

也就是说，1000 万部仅占郭明錤预测今年 iPhone 18 Pro 机型 20-2200 万部的三分之一。 与此同时，郭明池仍然认为，苹果供应商到 2026 年将仅售出 7-800 万部可折叠 iPhone。 由于数量相对较少，苹果公司在发布当天可能很难在 40 多个国家/地区备货。

值得记住的是，交错上市是该报告消息来源的说法，但尚未得到证实。 不管怎样，我们应该很快就能确定。 距离 iPhone Ultra 的发布只有几周的时间了，我们预计它将配备约 7.7 至 7.8 英寸的内屏、5.5 英寸的覆盖屏、厚度约 4.5 毫米，起价将超过 2,000 美元。 苹果的 iPhone 发布会最有可能在 9 月 8 日星期二或 9 月 9 日星期三举行。
